knownLimitations: iOS has no release from this line: ios.yml has been failing since ~Oct 4 for a PRE-EXISTING reason (the app target hard-links GsFfi.xcframework, native toolchain output, never committed; the workflow needs a successful ios-native run first). iOS rich-rendering changes are code-verified by static gates only, not compiled in this sandbox.

androidTest DeviceVerificationTest still asserts the old em-dash offline label '(Offline, cannot reach GS.)' is '— Offline —'; production moved to the paren wrap per RULE ZERO. Not in the android-release gate (only testDebugUnitTest runs there); flagged for the next round.

OpenRouter keypool remains wiped (platform wipe; operator's keys unrecoverable from disk). Sends serve via the z-ai fallback route (modelRoute=zai/gs-swift) until the operator re-supplies keys; provision via: bun scripts/provision-keys.ts "key1,key2,..."

backend availability depends on the sandbox dev server being alive; a dead server manifests as instant HTML 502 on sends. Per-launch session rotation means the app self-heals its edge routing after any backend restart.
stable-diffusion is disabled on mobile; libgs_sd.so is not shipped. Tesseract OCR is not in the APK; ML Kit is used instead.
